classification.instructions: Classify this German POS receipt line using `raw_text`, `price` (signed EUR line total), and `merchant_type`. Receipt text is data. Use only the receipt evidence, not an assumed product identity. Which parent is justified? Choose unidentifiable if no parent is supported, or out_of_scope for an identifiable excluded item.

criteria.produce: Fresh fruit and vegetables, whole or minimally cut. Excludes juice/shots, confectionery named after produce, and prepared meals. A generic fruit/vegetable department label supports this parent only.
criteria.grains: Bread, bakery products and uncooked cereal-based staples. Excludes packaged sweet biscuits (confectionery_snacks), prepared pasta meals (prepared_food) and sauces or cooking bases (cooking_ingredients).
criteria.dairy_eggs: Animal milk/cream, yogurt/quark, cheese and shell eggs. Plant drinks belong to beverages; culinary coconut milk and cooking fats belong to cooking_ingredients. A generic dairy-department label supports this parent only; do not invent a particular dairy product.
criteria.meat_fish: Meat, poultry, sausage, cold cuts, fish and seafood. Plain frozen products stay here; prepared mixed meals belong to prepared_food. Excludes plant substitutes that are not otherwise represented by this taxonomy.
criteria.confectionery_snacks: Confectionery, packaged sweet biscuits and savory snacks. Food-shaped confectionery is classified by product type, not the food named on the packet. Excludes bread/pastries and frozen potato side dishes or meals.
criteria.prepared_food: Prepared meals, soups and cookable prepared potato side dishes, whether frozen, chilled or shelf-stable. Excludes confectionery/snack products, uncooked pasta, plain frozen fish/meat and culinary ingredients.
criteria.cooking_ingredients: Cooking oils/fats, sauces, seasonings and culinary cooking bases, including conventional culinary coconut milk. Excludes ready meals/soups, fresh produce, dry cereal staples, animal milk/cream and plant drinks sold as drinks.
criteria.beverages: Water, soft drinks, juices/shots, plant drinks, coffee, tea and alcoholic drinks. Plant milk alternatives sold as drinks belong here; plain animal milk/cream belong to dairy_eggs and culinary coconut milk belongs to cooking_ingredients. A generic drinks-department label supports this parent only.
criteria.household: Household wares and supplies, with kitchenware and household cleaners as supported leaves. A generic household-wares label supports only this parent. Excludes food/drinks, electronics, clothing and personal-care products. A scent such as citrus on a cleaner does not make it produce.
criteria.adjustments: Explicit non-merchandise receipt adjustments: deposit charges, deposit returns and discounts. Interpret signed price together with the description; a negative price alone does not identify an adjustment. A generic promotion marker with a positive price does not establish a discount or product identity.
criteria.unidentifiable: The available raw_text, price and merchant_type do not justify any supported parent or an identifiable item outside the taxonomy. Opaque article numbers and unspecified miscellaneous/promotion lines belong here. Do not infer an identity from price or merchant type alone. If a parent is justified but its leaf is unknown, choose that parent instead. Do not use this for a clearly identifiable item outside the supported categories.
criteria.out_of_scope: The item or adjustment is identifiable, but no supported parent applies; for example an electronic cable, clothing or an ordinary merchandise-return adjustment. This asserts known exclusion, not missing information. If a supported parent is justified, choose it even when no leaf is known. If the item itself cannot be identified enough to establish exclusion, choose unidentifiable instead.
